summary: Package beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP on install and import
details: testrrrd@2.0.0 ships a postinstall script (beacon.cjs) and a main entry (index.js) that both POST a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The beacon fires automatically on npm install (via scripts.postinstall) and on require('testrrrd') (via top-level code in index.js). The package self-describes as a 'compatibility shim' but exposes no real functionality: module.exports is a Proxy whose every property returns a no-op, so the only effect of installing or importing this package is the outbound beacon to the hardcoded collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
